notes.title: Theatre Tech Update (Multiplayer)
notes.notes:
Hi,

The theatre tech update is now available in multiplayer. The new scene is quite a bit more GPU intensive than the previous one, so please report any performance issues. This update should also fix connectivity issues that prevented some users from joining a multiplayer game. 

-The PuppetsVR team

notes.title: Theatre Tech Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30521899/33cccafc9c594d9660428759ad7cb8d0b194ac0f.jpg

Hello Puppeteers!

We are happy to bring the first major update to PuppetsVR! In this update, you will find a brand new theatre scene (only in singleplayer for now), which includes a shiny lighting console! The lighting console will let you program lighting cues before your show and play through each cue with the press of a single button! There is only a few supported commands for now, but we plan to expand on this functionnality as well as enable it for multiplayer. You can play around with it for now!

Example commands :

"Record Cue 1" records cue number 1
"Record Cue 2 Time 3" records cue number 2 with fade in/out time of 3
"Record Cue 3 Time 2/5" records cue number 3 with fade in time of 2 and fade out time of 5
"Cue 1" sets cue number 1 as active cue
"1+2+3 at Full" sets projectors 1, 2 and 3 intensity at full
"1 Thru 6 at 35" sets projectors 1 through 6 intensity at 35%
"Delete Cue 2" deletes cue number 2

Here is the changelog :

Much, much bigger theatre along with new art assets.
Better lighting.
Lighting console added. Control each light individually and program cues! 
Fixed issues with teleporting.
A bunch of smaller fixes.

And a video of the lighting cues in action : 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DZn3z-vzIls

And a few more pictures :

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30521899/0cbe7f685c7837457aca660d4be8b520bfd2c8ba.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30521899/67e1f9a9e00818dc96efee11bb454419e3b10b11.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30521899/6e49944e6a1eff7dba0fbfc5c24a7a0fde4251ea.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30521899/bdb953fe6606132538d77b26c9f1a7f52741deb0.jpg

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello puppeteers!

Chances are you've ran into issues if you've played PuppetsVR in the last few days. We've pushed a patched to fix the most glaring issues and hopefully the experience should be a bit smoother. Here is the changelog :

[FIXED] Voice chat not working
[FIXED] Weird hit detection on color selectors
[ADDED] Camera screen behind the booth to watch your performance


Please report any other issues you may run into. We'll be working on tutorials for new players to help you figure out the controls as well as advanced controls for more experienced puppeteers!
